newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: CM Telecom pays HK$8.8 mln for radio firm.
newsitem.headline: CM Telecom pays HK$8.8 mln for radio firm.

text.p: Singapore telecommunications company CM Telecom International Ltd said on Monday it had bought a trunked radio service provider in Hong Kong to speed up its entry into that sector of the market.

CM Telecom said in a statement the deal would accelerate the provision of trunked radio service in Hong Kong and give it access to customers in need of roaming services between Hong Kong and the Guandong Province of China.
CM Telecom said it paid HK$8.8 million for Townlink Ltd which holds a 10-year public radiocommunication service licence from the Hong Kong telecommunications authority.
The licence was effective from October 1 1992.
At the same time, CM Telecom said it had paid HK$2.2 million for a Kowloon property which houses the main equipment for operating the radio service.
